summary: The units are dense; pick α near 0 with all partial-product conditions (an open condition near p and near q), and take the gauge of depth ᾱα.

steps.claim: A unit α close to 0 such that (ᾱα)·(∏_{i<l} r_i)⁻¹ ∈ R for all l ≤ ϱ and all r near p or near q (open conditions; units dense a.e.); the gauge of depth ᾱα works.
